title: OpenAI releases GPT-5, which decides on its own when to think harder
summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 to everyone who uses ChatGPT. It combines a fast model for most questions, a deeper reasoning model for harder ones, and a router that quickly picks between them for each conversation. Plus subscribers get more usage, and Pro subscribers also get GPT-5 pro, a version that reasons even longer.
why_it_matters: People don't have to pick a model from a menu anymore. ChatGPT decides how much thinking each question needs.
